dut_coithi.title: Exam invigilation - Step 1: Log in
dut_coithi.description: Log in with your cb.dut.udn.vn account (once). Does NOT fetch salary data. After a successful login, the next step lets you pick semesters from a real list.

dut_deadline_diem.title: Grade deadlines - Step 1: Log in
dut_deadline_diem.description: Log in with your cb.dut.udn.vn account (once). Does NOT fetch student grades/names/IDs. After a successful login, the next step lets you pick semesters from a real list.

hocky.title: Choose semesters to track
hocky.description: You can select multiple semesters (e.g. both the current and next one, so nothing is missed if published early).
